# Kenney assets (CC0 1.0)

Source repositories (official, by Kenney — https://kenney.nl):
- https://github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-City-Builder (models/*.glb)
- https://github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-Racing (models/*.glb)

The full kits (City Kit Commercial/Roads/Suburban, Car Kit) are at
https://kenney.nl/assets and are also CC0.
